name: Supadata
summary: Transcripts and metadata of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and Facebook videos, YouTube search, AI extraction from video, and web page scraping to Markdown.

api_key.description: a Supadata API key (dash.supadata.ai > API key). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: Billed in credits; every response carries an x-billable-requests header with the credits it used (on a 202 job answer it is a precharge estimate, reconciled when the job finishes). Polling a job is free.
Transcript, extract and crawl can answer 202 with a jobId instead of a result: poll the matching job endpoint until it is done.
Transcript chunks give offset and duration in milliseconds.
Crawl, YouTube batch jobs, playlist and channel metadata and transcript translation are in the API but not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get a video transcript
endpoints.summary: Existing or AI-generated transcript of a video on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X or Facebook, or of a media file.

url.description: Video or post URL: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), Facebook, or a public media file URL. URL-encode it.

lang.description: Preferred transcript language, ISO 639-1; falls back to the first available language.

text.description: true returns plain text instead of timestamped chunks. Default false.

chunkSize.description: Maximum characters per chunk, 50 to 10000; only when text=false.

mode.description: native: only an existing transcript; generate: always AI-generate; auto (default): native, else generate. A file URL is always generate.

notes: 1 credit for a native transcript; 2 credits per minute of video for a generated one. A 206 (transcript unavailable) still costs 1 credit. Use mode=native to avoid AI generation costs.
A long video answers 202 with a jobId; poll supadata.transcript.job.

endpoints.name: Get a transcript job result
endpoints.summary: Status and, when done, the transcript of a job started by supadata.transcript.get.

endpoints.name: Get media metadata
endpoints.summary: Unified metadata (title, author, stats, media) of a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X or Facebook post.

url.description: URL of the post or video.

endpoints.name: Search YouTube
endpoints.summary: Videos, channels, playlists or movies matching a query, with filters.

uploadDate.description: Upload date filter (videos and movies only).

duration.description: short <4 min, medium 4-20 min, long >20 min (videos and movies only).

features.description: Feature filters, repeated: hd, subtitles, creative-commons, 3d, live, 4k, 360, location, hdr, vr180.

limit.description: 1 to 5000. When set, the API pages for you and returns up to this many results with no nextPageToken.

nextPageToken.description: Token from the previous page; other filters are then ignored (query is still required).

notes: Without limit: 1 credit per page and a nextPageToken. With limit: ceil(limit / 20) credits.

endpoints.name: List a YouTube channel's video IDs
endpoints.summary: Video, Short and live-stream IDs of a channel.

type.description: Which videos, default all (regular videos first, then Shorts, then live).

notes: Returns IDs only; get details with supadata.metadata.get.

endpoints.name: Scrape a web page to Markdown
endpoints.summary: Main content of one page as Markdown, with its links.

noLinks.description: true strips Markdown links from the content.

lang.description: Preferred content language, ISO 639-1 (sets Accept-Language). Default en.

endpoints.name: Map a website's links
endpoints.summary: All links found across a website.

endpoints.name: Extract structured data from a video
endpoints.summary: Start an AI job that watches a video and returns data shaped by a prompt and/or JSON Schema.

url.description: Video or post URL: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), Facebook, or a public media file URL. URL-encode it.

prompt.description: What to extract, in plain language. Required unless schema is set; do not put JSON structure here.

schema.description: JSON Schema of the output. Required unless prompt is set. Large maxItems/maxLength bounds are rejected with 400 before any credits are used.

notes: Starts a billed job: it only produces data and changes nothing else in your account.
A read over POST that spends credits. Asynchronous: returns a jobId; poll supadata.extract.result.
Videos up to 3 hours and 2 GB, public only.

endpoints.name: Get an extract job result
endpoints.summary: Status and, when done, the extracted data of a job from supadata.extract.start.
